Leave your comments on this PR: https://t.co/3EggY9KC3C — Teknium 🪽 (@Teknium) November 21, 2026 Nous Research is about to ship a full redesign of Hermes Desktop, and co-founder Teknium has teased a wider roadmap around it. In a short list posted on X, he named Desktop Redesign, Mobile App, Proactivity, and Bots Market, along with two unfinished entries: one reading "Google" followed by a blank, and a final line left entirely empty. Asked about timing, Teknium said the new desktop app is done, the team is fixing issues found internally, and users should be able to try it early next week. Desktop Redesign Google ___???? Mobile App Proactivity Bots Market ____________ ???? Hermes Release Watch, an unofficial account tracking Hermes updates, shared what it calls in-progress designs. The app opens to a new home screen with every agent and its chats in one sidebar, and each agent gets its own page and settings. Routines live in one place, where users can create new ones and check every run, while skills, plugins, and tools share a single page. The designs also show light and dark themes, a phone layout, and a switch back to the classic look. EARLY NEXT WEEK IS THE WORD FOR THE NEW HERMES DESKTOP. The full redesign is built and getting its final polish now. Here's what it should look like. ▸ Open to a new home screen, with every agent and its chats in one sidebar ▸ Give each agent its own page and settings ▸ See… pic.twitter.com/QGMEqfuUPY It’s done we’re just fixing any issues found internally now. Should be able to try early next week The Bots Market is next. Teknium confirmed that a bots market is coming to the Hermes Market, next to skills and plugins. According to Hermes Release Watch, picking a ready-made bot and hitting Add Bot turns it into a personal Hermes profile. The account compared the idea to Grok Bot , except that it runs on the user's own Hermes. Early bots reportedly include Inbox Brief for triaging email, Research Desk for sourced answers, Meeting Wrap for next steps, Market Lookout for competitor changes, and Rewards Planner for card perks. Users could try each bot on a sample task first, and scheduled jobs would stay off until they pick a time. 🚨 BREAKING: HERMES IS GETTING A BOT MARKETPLACE. Skills. Plugins. And now Bots. Pick a ready-made bot, hit Add Bot, and it becomes your own Hermes profile. A focused teammate instead of a blank chat. It's what people love about Grok Bot. Except this one runs on your Hermes.… pic.twitter.com/ChHspU9R4k Proactivity is the most concrete hint. Teknium openly admitted Hermes has had no real proactivity so far and asked users to comment on an open pull request that is step one of that work. With it, Hermes notices things like a flight, an appointment, a deadline, or a habit, and proposes a scheduled job on a "Schedule this job?" card. Anyone have thoughts on proactivity in Hermes? Leave your comments on this PR: https://t.co/3EggY9KC3C The mobile app is also coming, with Hermes Release Watch pointing to December. The Google blank is still unexplained, though we know that Nous is working with Google to bring Gemini subscriptions into Hermes Agent . Together, these moves push Hermes, the open-source agent, toward the bot-first, always-on experience offered by Grok Bot, Muse, and ChatGPT Dots . Source
